content:
I have a source file Fmt.roc that passes roc check but fails roc test with compiler errors but error detail.

simon@neckbeard:~/working/roc-sfmt$ roc check package/Fmt.roc
No errors found in 26ms for package/Fmt.roc
simon@neckbeard:~/working/roc-sfmt$ roc test package/Fmt.roc
Ran 3 tests in 17.8 ms.:
    0 passed
    0 failed
    2 compiler errors
simon@neckbeard:~/working/roc-sfmt$

roc --version: Roc compiler version nightly-2026-10-09-258ab27

Any idea on what the errors are and/or why the detail isn't being reported?
sounds like a bug! Can you open a github issue with steps to reproduce? :smile:

Oh, I see that the underlying error is me putting a non-function in the where clause.
My bad.
no worries, we should handle that case better anyway!
